scope: GNK DINAMO Ltd. Group enterprise operating and governance model

principles.automationTarget: 99% automated operations with 1% reserved for presidential approval or direct decision
principles.presidentialAuthority: No digital, operational or AI function may override the President of the Group.
principles.publicAccuracy: Public governance pages may show only confirmed events, meetings, decisions and summaries approved for publication.
principles.internalRecordkeeping: Detailed agendas, minutes, proposals, votes, attachments, execution notes and audit trails are kept internally in Operator OS.
principles.entityFlexibility: Each group company may have its own management structure, committees, calendars and processes while remaining connected to the group-level operating model.

requiresPresidentApproval: DNS, secrets, Cloudflare production routing or infrastructure changes
legal, financial, ownership or contractual commitments
changes to group ownership, UBO, governance or corporate structure

publicGovernanceTimeline.purpose: Provide a credible public record of selected governance activity without exposing confidential details.
publicGovernanceTimeline.privacyRule: Detailed minutes, attachments, proposals and voting records remain internal unless separately approved for publication.

operatorOS.controlPattern: AI prepares, routes and executes permitted work; President approves the 1% of matters that carry legal, financial, reputational, strategic, security or production risk.
